after.name: user_editcount
after.comment: Stores user edit counts, distributed across shards to support high-volume update scenarios. Each user can have multiple rows (shards) with their edit count split across them. The total edit count for a user is the sum of uec_count across all shards for that user.

columns.name: uec_shard
columns.comment: Shard number for distributing write load. Multiple rows per user allow concurrent updates without lock contention.
